title: Местные идолы OVA
alt: Как простые старшеклассницы идолами пытались стать / Futsuu no Joshikousei ga [Locodol] Yattemita. Locodol OVA 普通の女子校生が【ろこどる】やってみた。OVA
description: 14 и 15 серии Futsuu no Joshikousei ga Yatte Mita.

en:
A new OVA for the idol girls series Futsuu no Joshikousei ga  Yatte Mita. has been announced on the anime’s official Twitter. The news was first given at the 2nd Early Summer Nagarekawa Festival which took place at the Differ Ariake Arena in Tokyo today, and consisted of live events including the main cast of the anime.

Episode 1: Christmas Special
Episode 2: We Tried Making a PV
